title: Define the finish
description: The crates can move, but the game does not know when to celebrate. Return True when every crate is on a goal.
hint: Help me return board.all_crates_on_goals() from is_complete(). Explain the Boolean result and when it should be True.
starter: # A crate puzzle: your code defines its controls and rules.

guide.instruction: Return board.all_crates_on_goals() so all goals must be covered.
guide.review: Try an unfinished board, then finish it. Only the completed board should celebrate.
